coverage.notes: Narrative-only walk-through by Foust Engineering (D. Foust PE), inspected 2020-12-07; no dollar figures, so all finding estimate_usd are null. Pages 1-16 are the narrative for the 8 property groups; pages 17-47 are photograph captions (corroboration only, no separate facts). Flat roofs were excluded from the walk-through (contracted separately) for 420 Morrison, 2800-2826 Banwick, 2012-2026 Zettler, 2000-2002 Zettler and 2002-2008 Zettler; no roof condition is stated for them. Many suite interiors were not accessed (Banwick, Zettler). Report headings 2000-2002 and 2002-2008 Zettler together cover the 2000-2008 Zettler group.
